readings.Aries: The desire you've been intellectualising has a body. Let it. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Taurus: Your instinct to stay is correct. The reason you're staying is worth examining. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Gemini: Your mind generates options at a rate that makes choosing feel like loss. It isn't. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Cancer: Your intuition about what someone else is feeling is usually right. Your interpretation of why may not be. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Leo: Your relationships are better when you are being yourself rather than the best version of yourself. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Virgo: There is a small pleasure available to you right now that your efficiency has been routing around. Take it. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Libra: There is something you find beautiful about someone that you haven't told them. Tell them. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Scorpio: The transformation you're in the middle of is not comfortable. It's not supposed to be. Let this one be easy.
readings.Sagittarius: You've been framing a limitation as a cage. Most cages are actually just rooms with closed doors. The first instinct was right.
readings.Capricorn: You have given the work everything. The work has given back. Notice what it hasn't given. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Aquarius: There is more warmth in you than your concepts allow for. Let some of it out today. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Pisces: The feeling you can't name is trying to tell you something that language hasn't caught up to yet. The timing is better than it feels.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
